clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, novice Forsaken warlocks gather skulls from mindless undead. Venya Marthand asks for them as a test of their will before teaching them the dark arts of summoning.

In Deathknell, Venya Marthand guides newly raised Forsaken who have a gift for dark magic. She sends them to subdue Rattlecage Skeletons near the ruined smithy and bring back their severed skulls. The trial tests whether a fledgling warlock can bend creatures from beyond this world to their command. It also lays the groundwork for breaching the void and binding a first demonic servant.
